probes.name: automatic
probes.source:
Function Snap() As String
Dim c As Range,s As String
s="mode=" & CStr(Application.Calculation) & ";state=" & CStr(Application.CalculationState) & ";values="
For Each c In ActiveSheet.Range("E1:E3").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & TypeName(c.Value2) & ":" & CStr(c.Value2) & "|"
Next
s=s & ";hidden="
Dim r As Long
For r=2 To 6
s=s & CStr(r) & ":" & CStr(ActiveSheet.Rows(r).Hidden) & "|"
Next
Snap=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim s As String,v As Variant
Application.Calculation=-4105
Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("ID","N")
Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("a",10)
Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("b",20)
Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("c",30)
Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("d",40)
Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("e",50)
Range("H1").Value="N"
Range("H2").Value=">=30"
Range("E1").Formula="=SUBTOTAL(109,B2:B6)"
Range("E2").Formula="=AGGREGATE(9,5,B2:B6)"
Range("E3").Formula="=E1+E2"
Application.Calculate
Application.Calculation=-4105
s="before=[" & Snap() & "]"
v=Range("A1:B6").AdvancedFilter(1,Range("H1:H2"))
s=s & ";return=" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v) & ";filtered=[" & Snap() & "]"
Application.Calculate
s=s & ";calculated=[" & Snap() & "]"
ActiveSheet.ShowAllData
s=s & ";shown=[" & Snap() & "]"
Application.Calculate
s=s & ";shownCalculated=[" & Snap() & "]"
Application.Calculation=-4105
Probe=s
End Function
